method: fresh tessdata_best English LSTM fine-tuning plus image-only ruled-row geometry
split: angle 1 train / angle 2 validation / angle 3 sealed final test; same two documents
limitations: Only two source documents; same-document angle test is not independent document generalization.
First sealed-angle evaluation was 85.42%; after debugging angle 3 it is a reused test.
Weights use angle 1 only; angle 3 was never added to recognizer training.
Some names, course codes, grades and issue dates still require visual review.
Timing may reflect concurrent local development work; no latency guarantee.
API smoke uses an in-process client; Docker server has not been started or deployed.

reproduce.starter_requirement: Place tessdata_best/eng.traineddata in tmp/photo_ocr_training/eng_best.traineddata; match starter SHA256 for this experiment.
